messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "get up slowly from sitting or lying down"
set: ["get up slowly from sitting or lying down", "avoid getting up quickly from sitting or lying down", "avoid getting up too fast from a sitting or lying position", "avoid sudden standing from sitting or lying position to prevent dizziness", "new or worsening breathlessness when lying down", "get up slowly and steady yourself to prevent a fall", "lying down flat until medical help arrives", "increase dose slowly", "slows down digestion", "tumors break down", "start taking it slowly", "slowly over the day", "medicines broken down by CYP3A4", "get medical help", "flush unused tablets or oral solution down the toilet", "do not double up to catch up"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
